{{Quote|Here, take this&mdash;my ''trooper torch'' has always brought me luck!|Thill to Kralla|<ref name="Downhill" />}}
The '''trooper torch''' was a form of [[Head lamp/Legends|head lamp]] used by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Thill]] used this device while on a [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|mission]] to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. During the mission, Thill gave his trooper torch to [[Kralla]], a [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] child, to comfort her.
